candidates.change_summary: Change the final returned value from true to false so transfer always returns false when it completes.
Invert the success check so call failures do not revert and instead cause the function to return false early (changing returned value on some inputs).
Replace the multiply-by-1e18 in the call value with v[i] (removing the scaling), changing which amount is forwarded to the external contract and thus potentially changing observable behavior.
Change the require that checks msg.sender to require that tx.origin matches the original address, altering who is allowed to call transfer and thus observable behavior.
Remove the require that _tos.length > 0, allowing transfer to be called with an empty list which changes observable behavior (previously reverted).
